## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## PAYROLL & EMPLOYEE PAYMENT PROCESSING ⭐ NEW
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation:v1** - ⭐ BEST FIT FOR PAYROLL OPS: Processes merit increases and compensation adjustments; integrates with payroll cycles; maintains audit trails for compliance; validates against organizational policies; handles Employee and Compensation entity types

## COMPENSATION POLICY & PAYROLL REGULATIONS
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - Enforces compensation policies and payroll regulations; validates salary adjustments
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationChangeProcessor:v1** - Validates compensation modifications against payroll processing timelines

## PRODUCT COMPLIANCE & BOM VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - ⭐ EXACT FIT: Validates BOM against regulatory & engineering standards; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance docs

## EQUIPMENT MODIFICATION & SERVICE VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ EQUIPMENT VALIDATION FOR PRODUCTION READINESS: Assesses affected IT equipment & digital twin configs during engineering changes; routes service tickets by criticality; ensures infrastructure alignment

## SAFETY COMPLIANCE FOR ENGINEERING CHANGES ⭐
- **sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1** - Automates safety validation across engineering changes, materials, and product items

## INCIDENT ANALYSIS & ROOT CAUSE (EHS)
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Analyzes SafetyIncidents to identify root causes & recommend corrective actions
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1** - Coordinates safety incident workflows

## PROCUREMENT - PURCHASE ORDER MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - ⭐ DIRECT PO EXECUTION: REST API for creating, updating, monitoring POs

## PROCUREMENT - SOURCING CAMPAIGN & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1** - Retrieves sourcing campaigns, customer accounts, and vendor relationship information

## PROCUREMENT - WORKFORCE COST CORRELATION ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI:v1** - ⭐ BEST FIT FOR WORKFORCE-PROCUREMENT COST ANALYSIS: Integrates employee compensation, payroll, workforce assignments with procurement workflows

## PROCUREMENT & MATERIAL IMPACT FOR PRODUCT TRANSITIONS
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - CORE for product transition procurement impact

## SALES OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION & PRIORITIZATION ⭐
- **sap.crm:agent:OpportunityQualificationAdvisor:v1** - ⭐ PERFECT FIT FOR SALES OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION: Autonomously evaluates sales opportunities against qualification criteria

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification; coordinates sales strategy adjustments
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers coordinated customer engagement

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - Sales-specific compensation

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders

## PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD ANALYSIS ⭐
- **my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1** - ⭐ PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD: REST API for OEE data
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Real-time quality monitoring; detects deviations

## WORKFORCE COMPENSATION & LABOR ALLOCATION ⭐
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - Automates workforce capability alignment with project resource requirements
